subject: science
cluster: Patterns of the sky and seasons

items.prompt:
Daylight is
A) the light part of the day between sunrise and sunset
B) a kind of rock
C) the Moon
D) a star
items.answer: A) the light part of the day between sunrise and sunset

steps: Daylight is the light part of the day.

items.prompt:
Which season has the most daylight?
A) Summer
B) Winter
C) They are equal
D) None

steps: Summer has the most hours of daylight.

items.prompt:
Which season has the least daylight?
A) Summer
B) Winter
C) Spring only
D) None

steps: Winter has the fewest hours of daylight.

items.prompt:
It gets dark earlier in
A) summer
B) winter
C) both the same
D) neither

steps: Winter has less daylight, so it gets dark earlier.

items.prompt:
Summer days are ____ than winter days.
A) longer
B) shorter
C) the same
D) darker

steps: Summer has more daylight, so days are longer.

items.prompt:
At 8 in the evening, it is more likely to be light in
A) December
B) June
C) both
D) neither

steps: June (summer) has more daylight, so it stays light later.

items.prompt:
You can play outside later in the summer evening because
A) there is more daylight in summer
B) winter has more daylight
C) the Sun turns off
D) it is always dark
items.answer: A) there is more daylight in summer

steps: More summer daylight keeps it light into the evening.

items.prompt:
The amount of daylight is related to the time of year because there is
A) more daylight in summer and less in winter
B) the same daylight all year
C) more daylight in winter
D) no daylight ever
items.answer: A) more daylight in summer and less in winter

steps: Daylight is longest in summer and shortest in winter.
